thread:
incident-bot: 🔔 PAGER: P1 — Dedicated pool node eviction detected (stratus-dedpool-3). Affected tenant: StratusCo (VPC). Autoscaler evict due to GPU ECC errors. Triggered at 2026-03-15T09:00:00Z. Paging oncall: @Aisha.
Aisha: I’m on it, ack. pulling logs + checking node health.
Aisha: Diego, can you confirm current running jobs for StratusCo on that node? we need to know active sessions.
Diego: Checking. node=stratus-dedpool-3, running containers: 4 pinned workloads for stratusco-model-v2 (low-qps batch), 2 other tenant jobs (non-stratus).
Priya: Got telemetry — GPU ECC count spiked then kernel reset. nvml reports ECC=7 over 5m, GPU temp normal. Looks like soft ECC degradation.
Aisha: Priority here is tenant isolation and avoiding inference errors for StratusCo. Plan: 1) cordon + drain node 2) move stratusco routes to fallback pool (stratus-fallback-cpu) 3) spin replacement node in the same pool 4) notify customer and SRE hardware.
Ellen: From customer-eng: StratusCo is on enterprise SLAs, they have 5 reserved instances. They’ll want a handoff + ETA for replacement. Please include a short mitigation note we can send.
Aisha: On it. Priya, run cordon+drain and post command + result.
Priya: Running:
```
kubectl cordon stratus-dedpool-3
kubectl drain stratus-dedpool-3 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --force
```
Priya: Drain started — eviction in progress. pod eviction status: 3/6 completed. Two stratusco pods are still terminating (stuck on pre-stop script).
Diego: I’ll check logs for termination hang. Looks like pre-stop retries hitting KMS call for model keys, timing out. 502 from KMS endpoint. Might need temporary key bypass for graceful shutdown.
Ken: I can route calls to the fallback route at the loadbalancer layer. Prep command to flip route for tenant stratusco -> stratus-fallback-cpu. Need ack to proceed.
Aisha: Do it. Mark as temporary. Add rate-limits to fallback to avoid queue storms.
Ken: Done: route updated, TTL applied. Verified 200 responses from fallback model endpoint. Traffic metric shows 95% shifted within 30s. :thumbsup: 
Ellen: Draft to customer: "We detected a GPU node fault in your dedicated pool and have routed your traffic to a verified CPU fallback. No data was lost; we're replacing the node and will provide an ETA in 30 minutes." Approve?
Aisha: Approve, send now. Keep message concise.
Ellen: Sent to StratusCo CSM and primary contacts. They replied: "Thanks — keep us posted. Any risk to latency-sensitive flows?"
Diego: Fallback increases 95th latency ~3x for some calls. We should flag degraded performance in the ticket and link to the route change.
Priya: Drain finished. Node shows 0 pods. Replacement request sent to infra-autoscaler for a new instance (type: a40-1). Autoscaler: spawn in pool stratus-dedpool.
incident-bot: INFO: Replacement instance request submitted (request_id=rep-21685-01). Estimated spin-up 6-10 minutes.
Ken: I’ll kick an oncall handoff to hardware team: @Ken -> @Diego for infra followup after replacement.
Aisha: Thanks team. Next steps: monitor fallback latency, confirm new node joins and passes health checks, reassign tenant back after validation, and schedule a HW replace window if ECC recurs. I’ll update the incident channel and create post-incident doc.
Ellen: Customer acknowledged, appreciates quick mitigation.
Diego: New node joined pool and passed readiness probes at +7m. Re-scheduling stratusco pods to new node now.
Priya: Post-migration checks: all stratusco pods running on new node, no restarts. KV-cache warmup complete.
Aisha: Re-activate primary route back to dedpool. Ken?
Ken: Route reverted, traffic rebalanced. 95th latency back to baseline within 2m.
incident-bot: RESOLVED: P1 incident auto-closed. Summary: GPU ECC spike on stratus-dedpool-3 caused node eviction; traffic routed to CPU fallback; new node provisioned and tenant moved; customer notified. Incident duration: 9m.
Aisha: Filing followup: schedule hardware RMA for stratus-dedpool-3 and add ECC thresholds to alerting. Assign to Diego for RMA coordination.
Diego: Will open RMA ticket with rack ops. noted.
Aisha: Closing thread here. Thanks all. :heart:
summary: Dedicated pool GPU node ECC spike evicted node; drained, traffic routed to CPU fallback, replacement provisioned, tenant restored, customer notified
